items.item_text: Degree in information technology, informatics, public health or related fields.
An advanced educational qualification or Graduate Business Degree (e.g., Masters of Business, Technology or Public Administration) or equivalent combination of education and experience is preferred.
Experience in communicating to public health stakeholders verbally and/or in writing.
Knowledge and experience with Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS).
30% - Lead Data Quality Assurance, Compliance & Maintenance of Laboratory Information System

Demonstrated successful interpersonal, oral and written communications skills to interact diplomatically with diverse groups and to exercise judgment and tact in interactions with faculty, staff, students and the public.
Ability to exercise initiative, originality, and judgement in applying established principles and practices to new and innovative opportunities.
Proven strong political acumen skills and ability to apply in diverse, complex organization.
Proven ability to apply high ethical standards to business practices and decision-making.

Proven ability to handle highly sensitive and confidential issues that require independent judgement and strict discretion, and maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive, confidential and/or privileged information.
Ability to represent the University at the highest levels an in public forums with professionalism and integrity.
